language.description: BCP 47 tag of the spoken lines, e.g. en, zh-CN

url.description: Open this page when playback starts (if the tab is elsewhere)

app.description: Bundle identifier of the app to bring forward

unitsPerSec.description: Speech units per second (an English word = 1, a CJK character = 0.5)

leadSecs.description: Extra time to start and finish a line

card.description: Default card placement when a step has no spotlight

act.description: click: click inside the spotlight to advance. read: the bar fills while the cursor rests in the spotlight (or always, without a target). wait: until a condition or `secs`. manual: advance with the hotkey

say.description: The line to say. Empty = do it silently

tag.description: Short action label above the line, e.g. "Click Sign in"

how.description: Override the automatic "how to do this" hint
